verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own pages say founders can file all documents through SOSPortal, including mergers and conversions. They show Form 205 (LLC Certificate of Formation) can be filed online, and that payment works by ACH or credit card on a 24/7 platform with drafts, a shopping cart, expedited options and status tracking. The site also states plainly that founders can "Start a business" on SOSPortal. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end online filing, since the filing host itself was not fetched.
